title: Inconsistent behaviour between dev and build in parallel routing.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

labels.name: Linking and Navigating
labels.description: Related to Next.js linking (e.g., <Link>) and navigation.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/jainmohit2001/nextjs-features

### To Reproduce

1. Clone the mentioned project
2. `npm install`
3. `npm run dev` (for development)
4. `npm run build` followed by `npm run start` (for production server) 

### Current vs. Expected behavior

The [src/app/routing/parallel-routing/@slot1/layout.tsx](https://github.com/jainmohit2001/nextjs-features/blob/58e9256befc54d8de3394a4395af479fe24f104e/src/app/routing/parallel-routing/%40slot1/layout.tsx) should be visible for the `@slot1`. In dev mode, this works as expected, but in build mode, the layout seems to be missing. 

### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash

  Arch: x64
```

### Which area(s) are affected? (Select all that apply)

Routing (next/router, next/navigation, next/link)
